sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
In Re: Crl. Misc. Bail Application We have heard learned counsel for the appellant and the learned A.G.A. for the State.

The accused appellant- Dharmdev Harihan, who has been convicted in Session Trial No. 40 of 2014 (State vs. Dharmdev Harijan) arising out of Case Crime No. 124 of 2014, under Section 376(2) I.P.C.
and 6 POCSO Act, Police Station Khampar, District Deoria and sentenced.
The allegation against accused appellant is of subjecting a five year old victim to sexually assault.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the appellant has been falsely implicated on account of village enmity.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is languishing in jail since 11.02.2014 and has therefore completed almost nine years of incarceration.
It is also submitted that accused inserted keys in the private parts of the victim is not believable and in fact injuries have been caused to the minor in a sugar-cane field.
The counsel for appellant further states that on account of enmity, the applicant has been falsely implicated.
We have perused the records of the present case.
The victim has been found to be minor girl.
Her hymen was found fresh torn.
Perineal tear from clitoris, urethra to anal margin (splinctor) mist ozeeing were present.

Two pair of slide prepared from vaginal smear, one sent to pathology D.H.
Deoria and one pair given to same were noticed by doctor, who conducted MLC.
Recent injury on vagina and perinium present the same are caused by external trauma.

In the opinion of the doctor,
injury is caused on the private parts.
Learned A.G.A., on the other hand, has opposed the grant of bail.
Considering the age of the victim and also the medical evidence which prima-facie supports commissioning of offence on victim, we decline the prayer made for grant of bail.
The observation made herein above shall have no bearing on the final outcome of the appeal.
Accordingly, the bail is rejected.

Order Date :- 20.2.2023 A. Farooqui  Dharmdev Harihan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98351302/
